Q1.reading: Every record has an explicit `layer` field; raw (L0) and facts (L1) are populated by default; episodes, summaries, graph, profile, observations and communities are opt-in layers.

Q2.reading: Library-first inline runner draining a durable outbox in the same store; leftover work resumes on the next open; dbos and taskiq are optional drainers.

Q3.reading: Build the deterministic value-history view AND an observation layer for recurring patterns only (code-grouped, model-worded only for groups that changed). O-15 is reopened from 'none' to 'patterns only'; observations are an opt-in L4 layer (Q1).

Q4.reading: Embedded profile: auto Ladybug else SQL adjacency (M-18 A). Server profile: Postgres + pgvector + Postgres full text for records, Neo4j for the graph, fed only through the outbox.

Q5.answer: Jina on every read if installed
Q5.reading: Jina v3.5 reranks every read wherever the model is installed; the pre-run gate is a CPU-only mode; the eval harness forces it on.

Q6.reading: Jina stays for research and evaluation; the library default is 'Jina if installed', with a permissively licensed reranker named as the commercial fallback (licence check is a research task).

Q7.reading: Undeclared attributes coexist (registry default); a new value contests the old one only when extraction marks a change; learned cardinality only as reviewable proposals.

Q8.answer: Assistant exemption in the chat preset only
Q8.reading: Base firewall signals on every channel, extended and semantic on top; the assistant-role exemption only in the chat data-shape preset.
